findings.title: Pod spread or affinity rules cannot be met
findings.cause: no node can run the pod: 1 node fails its topology spread constraints: its constraint over kubernetes.io/hostname has minDomains 3, and the nodes form 1 domain (kd-faults-control-plane); while there are fewer domains than minDomains, the scheduler takes the smallest domain to hold 0 pods, so no domain may hold more than maxSkew (1) of the pods the constraint counts, and 1 such pod already run; Deployment web has 1 of 2 replicas ready

evidence.detail: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 node(s) didn't match pod topology spread constraints. preemption: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 No preemption victims found for incoming pod.

findings.fix: Lower minDomains to the number of kubernetes.io/hostname domains the nodes form (1), or drop it; or add nodes in more domains.
